cost_script:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Paired local diagnostic of source-location reporting's test-cycle cost."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
original = Path('/workspace/Projects/Marimay/Marimay-Examples/marimay-config')
app = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='perf-config-', dir=out))
for p in original.rglob('*'):
    if p.is_file() and not any(x in p.relative_to(original).parts for x in ('build', '.git', '.mmay', '__pycache__')):
        target = app / p.relative_to(original)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(p, target)
compilers = {'baseline': repo / 'build/release/mmay-d094-test-location-baseline',
             'candidate': repo / 'build/release/mmay-d095-test-location-candidate'}
shutil.copy2(out / 'final/mmay', compilers['candidate'])
compilers['candidate'].chmod(0o755)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
expected = (out / 'config-tests.log').read_bytes()
assert b'7 passed; 0 failed' in expected
records = []
artifacts = {}

def run(name, phase, round_index):
    command = [str(compilers[name]), 'test', str(app), '--engine', 'both']
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
    seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
    assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout == expected and not result.stderr, (name, phase, result)
    records.append({'name': name, 'phase': phase, 'round': round_index,
        'seconds': seconds, 'command': command, 'exit': result.returncode,
        'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest()})
    return seconds

metadata = {'schema':'marimay.cp42.test-location-cost/1', 'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'platform':platform.platform(), 'load_before':os.getloadavg(),
    'battery_before':subprocess.check_output(['pmset','-g','batt'],text=True),
    'app_root':str(app),'compiler_sha256':{n:sha(p) for n,p in compilers.items()},
    'source_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(app)):sha(p) for p in app.rglob('*.my')},
    'expected_stdout':expected.decode(),
    'limits':'Local interactive M2 diagnostic, no dedicated-host or OS-cold claim; no samples removed.'}
for name in compilers:
    previous = set(app.glob('.mmay/build/native/debug/*/program.c'))
    elapsed = run(name, 'first-native-artifact-build', 0)
    created = set(app.glob('.mmay/build/native/debug/*/program.c')) - previous
    assert len(created) == 1, (name, created)
    source = created.pop()
    artifacts[name] = {'generated_c_bytes':source.stat().st_size, 'generated_c_sha256':sha(source),
        'executable_bytes':(source.parent/'app').stat().st_size,
        'executable_sha256':sha(source.parent/'app'), 'path':str(source)}
    print(name, 'first build', round(elapsed, 3), flush=True)
for phase, count in [('warmup', 3), ('measured', 11)]:
    for index in range(count):
        order = ['baseline', 'candidate'] if index % 2 == 0 else ['candidate', 'baseline']
        for name in order:
            run(name, phase, index)
    print(phase, 'complete', flush=True)
metadata['records'] = records
metadata['artifacts'] = artifacts
metadata['load_after'] = os.getloadavg()
metadata['battery_after'] = subprocess.check_output(['pmset','-g','batt'],text=True)
metadata['summary'] = {}
for name in compilers:
    values = [r['seconds'] for r in records if r['name'] == name and r['phase'] == 'measured']
    median = statistics.median(values)
    quartiles = statistics.quantiles(values, n=4, method='inclusive')
    metadata['summary'][name] = {'median_seconds':median,
        'mad_seconds':statistics.median(abs(x-median) for x in values),
        'iqr_seconds':quartiles[2]-quartiles[0], 'min_seconds':min(values), 'max_seconds':max(values)}
(out/'cost.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(metadata['summary']), flush=True)
